output.summary: The defined root problem (PD-1) is that CHG-77 disabled idempotency-key enforcement on gateway capture retries on 2026-09-09, causing PSP timeout retries to produce a second capture per order and driving a ~25-30x spike in double-charge support tickets, not a customer-communication gap as originally requested by SH-CS. This was established by config-audit evidence (E-01), charge-ledger evidence matching duplicate captures to timeout retries exactly after the change (E-02), PSP logs isolating the cause to missing idempotency keys on retries (E-03), and the ticket-volume spike (E-04). The release decision is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION: only verification/monitoring actions were released (checking config state, duplicate-capture resolution, PSP dedup, and ticket trends), while the actual gateway re-enable fix was excluded from release scope because the current live rollback status is unverified, and a secondary question about ticket-spike composition remains open.
key_points: Root cause confirmed as hypothesis H-GATEWAY-IDEMPOTENCY-DISABLED (supported by E-01, E-02, E-03, E-04, E-05, E-08): disabling idempotency enforcement on capture retries makes the PSP fail to deduplicate retried captures.
The requester's framing (SH-CS, via CL-01/CL-03/E-06) that the fix is simply faster apology replies was tested as hypothesis H-COMMS-GAP-ONLY and REJECTED against E-01, E-02, E-03, E-04, E-05.
Alternative causes were also rejected: checkout-side duplicate requests (H-CHECKOUT-DUPLICATE-REQUESTS) and a PSP-side defect (H-PSP-SIDE-DEFECT), both contradicted by E-02, E-03, E-05.

Released scope was limited to verification actions tied to config-audit, payments-db, psp-logs, and crm-tickets (per solution_design release_scope); the actual mutating fix (set_capture_idempotency / enable_capture_idempotency_enforcement) was not released.
As of the last evidenced data (2026-09-10), 4 unresolved duplicate-capture orders remained open and unrefunded (E-08: O-90211, O-90244, O-90302, O-90318).
The DEFINE gate returned CONDITIONAL_PASS with deferred items tracked as verification obligations (VOBs), which carried through to the release decision.
limitations_explained: VOB-U-CURRENT-ROLLBACK-STATUS is open and required before release: whether CHG-77 has since been rolled back or retry behavior has changed between 2026-09-10 and today (2026-10-11) is unknown, so the gateway re-enable action was kept out of release scope.

VOB-R-2 is open and required before production: it is unknown what fraction of the W37-W38 ticket spike (E-04) reflects genuine unresolved duplicates versus authorization-hold confusion or already-reversed duplicates (H-TICKET-MISCLASSIFICATION / U-TICKET-MISCLASSIFICATION).
Ticket-volume alone may misstate whether the defect is resolved, since some double-charge tickets could be misclassified rather than genuine unresolved duplicate captures.

Ticket data has a 2-3 week reporting lag, so the ticket-based success criterion (SC-TICKETS) cannot be fully confirmed within the remaining contest time budget (70 minutes remaining per runtime data).
SR-R4, a proposed change-governance control requiring expiry/alerting on temporary config changes like CHG-77, was judged not implementable within this contest's time and tool surface.
